# Nexus MCP Connector

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

This repo will host the building block for an MCP client to connect
to MCP servers with Temporal Nexus acting as the durable transport under the hood. Specifically:

- **Inbound:** serves Nexus operations as MCP tools to any MCP client, allowing MCP clients to reach any Nexus service over MCP.
- **Outbound:** acts as a durable proxy to upstream MCP servers, by backing tool calls with Nexus and Standalone Activities.
- **Authoring:** provides building blocks to mark Nexus operations as MCP tools.
- **Workflow client:** call Nexus-backed MCP tools from Workflow code.

> [!NOTE]
> This project is currently experimental. APIs are subject to change.

## Development

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

# AGENTS.md

## Git Workflow

### Branch and PR Requirements

- **NEVER** push changes directly to the `main` branch.
- **ALWAYS** create a new branch for changes.
- **ALWAYS** submit a Pull Request for code review.
- Branch naming convention: `username/feature-name`.

### Commit Requirements

- When possible, use `[pkg]: <what changed>` for the first line of the commit message. `pkg` is the
  package or area, for example `[go/inbound]`, `[python]`, `[typescript]`, or `[ci]`.
- Do not add co-author attribution for AI agents.

## Code Style & Conventions

- Code comments state the mechanism and the reason. No incident history.

version: 2

updates:
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    cooldown:
      default-days: 14
    groups:
      github-actions:
        patterns: ["*"]
